subject: Nebula commit: capacity orchestration & vendor timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amir Khan <amir@nebulaanalytics.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Feb 2029 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nebula commit: high-level capacity ask and timing

Team — looping you in on the Nebula Analytics commitment signal we discussed on Friday. Amir confirmed intent to sign a Dedicated contract (NB-2029-47) conditioned on a Q2 ramp window and an initial reserved pool for inference (8 nodes equivalent) + burst to cloud for week-one scale. Key asks:

- Firm hardware ETA per vendor (OEM lead times + port/shipping risk)
- Cloud backstop costs for 8k token/session workloads (short-burst pricing)
- A staged onramp proposal (staging pool -> reserved -> full pool) tied to milestone payments

Attachments: [Attachment: Nebula_MAAP_request.xlsx] (Amir shared a draft MAP and expected go-live dates).

Immediate asks: Karthik — can you run an OEM ETA + SKU suggestion given Nebula's latency/SLA target (p95 < 200ms)? Vanessa — can you draft a staging/reserve plan and list required commit windows so we can sync procurement? Marissa — flag any commercial constraints (credits/discounts) we should bake into the MAP.

I want a one-page orchestration note by EOD Friday so I can send to Amir and Claire (their procurement lead). Thanks — Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com
[Attachment: Nebula_MAAP_request.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: TitanHW Sales <hw-sales@titanhardware.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Feb 2029 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nebula commit: OEM ETAs and SKU options

Marcus / team — quick OEM update after sync with TitanHW and a smaller secondary supplier (Aurex Systems). Summary below. See attached ETA ranges and recommended SKU mix.

OEM ETA windows (order lead time from PO issuance):
- TitanHW (preferred): Q2 build window: 6–10 weeks after PO; port & customs typical +2 weeks; conservative ETA: 8–12 weeks.
- Aurex (alternative): Q2–Q3: 4–8 weeks but limited availability for the 80GB variants; better for quantized/48GB lanes.

SKU recommendation (to meet p95 200ms with cost sensitivity):
1) Staging pool (30% capacity): mix of single-socket 80GB A100-equivalent -> low-latency for warmup.
2) Reserved pool (initial): 4x 80GB nodes + 4x 48GB quantized nodes (better unit-cost for steady throughput).
3) Burst/backstop: Cloud spot/pool with preapproved budget and routing policy.

Tradeoffs and constraints:
- TitanHW quoted blanket lead-time protection if we approve a Q2 slot (commit deposit required).
- If Nebula needs an earlier go-live (<8 weeks), we need a partial cloud-only backstop for first 30–45 days — expect ~15–25% uplift on token unit cost.

Attachments: [Attachment: TitanHW_ETA_Range_Q1Q2_2029.pdf]

Action items:
- Marcus: confirm whether Nebula will accept staged delivery (preferred) or requires all-in hardware.
- Vanessa: can you add staging timelines into the MAP so Titan can align production slots?

Karthik
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Amir Khan <amir@nebulaanalytics.com>, Claire DuPont <claire@sysprocurement.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Feb 2029 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nebula commit: proposed staging + reserves (draft MAP)

Team / Amir / Claire — attaching a short MAP (mutual action plan) draft that ties product milestones to procurement and payment windows. High level:

- Week 0: Contract signature + 25% deposit -> trigger TitanHW slot reservation and cloud-backstop credit (30 days).
- Week 6: Staging pool (partial hardware delivery 30% capacity) + integration runbook; customer acceptance test window.
- Week 12: Reserved pool online (initial 8-node equivalent).
- Week 20: Full reserved commit (scale based on usage trigger).

Risks & mitigations:
- OEM delays: include option to convert a portion of deposit to cloud credits (30-day conversion) if Titan misses the conservative ETA.
- Customs/port hold: recommend staggered shipments and split PO to mitigate single-port exposure.

Attachment: [Attachment: Nebula-MAP-v1.docx]

Amir — is the acceptance window above realistic from your procurement perspective? Claire — if we include the conversion-to-cloud-credits clause, will that satisfy Nebula's finance team?

Thanks, Vanessa
Director, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference

From: Amir Khan <amir@nebulaanalytics.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Feb 2029 10:19:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nebula commit: proposed staging + reserves (draft MAP)

Vanessa / Marcus / team — thanks for the detailed plan. A few clarifications from Nebula:

- Budget constraint: we have flexibility on timing but limited churn in Q2 headcount; prefer smoothing spend rather than big capital outlays. The conversion-to-cloud-credits option is attractive if it doesn't introduce material premium.
- Acceptance criteria: our SRE team needs a 7-day burn-in on staging pool; can you confirm you can provide a runbook and a named SRE contact?
- Can you firm up approximate cloud-backstop price range (USD per 1M tokens) for the first 30 days? We need that number for our procurement evaluation.

We remain committed to moving forward but need the financials to land cleanly.

Best — Amir
VP, Platform Engineering | Nebula Analytics

Quick commercial note from my side: we can structure the initial 25% deposit as 2x payments (10% on signature, 15% on PO submission to TitanHW) to reduce immediate cash pressure on Nebula. The conversion-to-cloud-credits clause will be priced at a small uplift (~10% on normal hosted rates) to cover our hedging exposure; I will get exact numbers from Finance by EOD Thursday and update the MAP.

- Draft updated MAP with split deposit and quantified cloud-backstop estimate.
- Coordinate with TitanHW on initial PO terms (preferred production slot hold clause).
- Provide named SRE contact & runbook link for the 7-day staging burn-in (will attach link to onboarding repo).

If that all works, I will send a DocuSign link for the signature path (contract + PO trigger) once Titan confirms slot availability.

Thanks — Marissa
